final.memo:
Since our initial engagement in June 2017, Nestlé has begun to address the core issues of portfolio complexity and operating underperformance [D07]. Management has now formally committed to an underlying margin target of 17.5–18.5% and a CHF20 billion buyback, both of which align with our core thesis [D03]. While organic growth of 2.4% remains modest, the structural shift toward greater capital efficiency and improved margins provides a clear path for shareholder value creation [D02; D03].

We recognize that global organizational change is a marathon, not a sprint [D05]. However, the persistence of a gap between our internal margin expectations and the company’s current operating reality necessitates continued vigilance and proactive engagement [D03; D06]. Today, we are releasing our 'NestléNOW' presentation to reinforce the urgency of this transformation and to sharpen the focus on execution milestones [D01; D04].

We choose to ADD to our position because the catalyst is active and the strategic direction is now institutionalized [D03; D07]. We continue to monitor the balance between necessary reinvestment to protect the brand and the realization of margin gains [D03; D05]. Our focus remains on the tangible conversion of revenue into cash and the disciplined simplification of the portfolio [D02; D04].
